text: Understanding databases is essential for anyone working with data. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store information in tables, which are organised rows and columns, much like a spreadsheet. To get information from these tables, you use queries—special commands that ask the database specific questions. Good data modeling is important because it helps you plan how your tables connect to each other before you start building. Finally, indexes make your queries much faster. An index works like a book's contents page, helping the database find the right data quickly instead of searching every row.
